The '''LXR-6 concussion grenade''' was a [[Concussion grenade/Legends#Physical|physical]] concussion [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]<ref name="BF guide" /> that were used on a few battlefronts during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] alike later used them during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="BF I" /> although not as much as [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. These concussion grenades had powerful magnetics and were utilized against armored vehicles during the war such as [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]]. The grenade would stick to the armor of the vehicle and detonate with a powerful blast designed to rip a hole through the vehicle's hull. While effective against armored vehicles, the grenades had a short blast radius and caused only minimum damage against infantry units.<ref name="BF guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
LXR-6 concussion grenades appear in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', although they are identified as such in the game's [[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|strategy guide]].
